question: Which page layouts does this object have, and which profile gets which?

steps.name: entity
steps.soql: SELECT DurableId FROM EntityDefinition WHERE QualifiedApiName = '{obj}'

steps.name: layouts
steps.soql: SELECT Name, LayoutType, CreatedBy.Name, CreatedDate, LastModifiedBy.Name, LastModifiedDate FROM Layout WHERE TableEnumOrId IN ({@entity.DurableId}) ORDER BY Name

steps.name: assignments
steps.soql: SELECT Profile.Name, Layout.Name, RecordType.Name FROM ProfileLayout WHERE TableEnumOrId IN ({@entity.DurableId}) ORDER BY Profile.Name LIMIT 2000

traps: A record page built with Dynamic Forms ignores the layout's fields; check meta.record-pages first.
